subject: design/plangate-carina-adapter
statement: the mapping is a typed table, ruled by the operator (2026-07-15): `issueType` `epic`/`task` → Carina `--type`; the `epic` *label* is elided (the type carries it); `local-agent` → `agent` (authorization); `operator` → `operator`; `kind:*` passes through; **any other label is auto-defined as a classification signal** via `carina signal def <name> classification` (idempotent — define iff absent) and then applied. `EnsureLabel` therefore never fails: a mapped-to engine-recognized signal already exists (no-op), and an unmapped one is materialized on the classification axis. This preserves every label as a queryable Carina signal without widening Carina's closed engine-recognized set (DINV-3). The full table is in the solution-shape.
